command: llvm-mc -triple=x86_64 -filetype=obj research/evidence/experiments/EXP-0065/fixture.asm -o out.o && llvm-objcopy -O binary --only-section=.text out.o out.bin
notes: All eight 0.36.0 rows, twice each, sixteen instructions and 60 bytes: the %rsp low rows are three bytes (8b 04 24 / 89 04 24), every %r12 row and every -ext row is four (41/44/45 ...). The base is template content -- ModRM = 04 and SIB = 24 -- because %rsp and %r12 share the low three bits 100 and the REX.B byte is the only bit that tells them apart; each row fixes its base and the register windows are disjoint (the -ext rows exclude 0-7). %rbp/%r13 stay on the zero-displacement shape (r/m = 101 at mod = 00 is RIP-relative). input_sha256 is fixture.asm (the source above); output_sha256 is the 60-byte .text.
